sample_unit: patient education materials (3 AI chatbots, 2 traditional sources, 15 myths)

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated and traditional CRPS patient education materials (Flesch Reading Ease)
links.effect: Gemini had the best readability (Flesch score 62); traditional PEMs and other AI-generated PEMs all scored <52, i.e., harder to read.
links.quote: Gemini had superior readability (Flesch score 62 as compared to Traditional PEMs and other AI generated PEMs all scoring <52) but lower specificity (66.67%) in debunking myths.

links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy of chatbot PEMs versus Cleveland Clinic and myth-debunking performance
links.effect: Cleveland Clinic accuracy 4.8 vs Gemini 3.4 (P=.004) and Llama 3.6 (P=.014); Gemini myth-debunking specificity 66.67%, ChatGPT 100%.
links.quote: Cleveland Clinic PEMs demonstrated the highest accuracy (4.8 ± 0.40 expressed as mean ± standard deviation, significantly outperforming Gemini (3.4 ± 0.49, P = .004) and Llama (3.6 ± 0.49, P = .014).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation comparing accuracy, readability, completeness, and myth-debunking capabilities of patient education materials generated by LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, Llama) versus institutional websites, evaluated by pain experts and readability metrics.
